channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: The Canadian Pacific Holiday Train returns to the North Country this Thanksgiving. It will visit multiple locations after the holiday meal. The train brings festive cheer to the community.

The Vermont Statehouse received its Christmas tree from the Delphas family of Rutland. The tree will be displayed as part of the holiday decorations. This marks the start of the festive season at the Statehouse.

Bromley Mountain Ski Resort has delayed its opening day to next weekend despite snowmaking efforts. Stratton Mountain and Bolton Valley have also postponed openings, with Bolton Valley aiming for December fifth. Jay Peak will open Friday with a special event for season passholders and guests.

A Rutland City family was displaced by fire for the second time this year. The November twenty-second fire damaged a building on Jackson Avenue. One elderly resident was treated for smoke inhalation at the hospital.
